description: Collect your iOS and Android application logs and send them to Bugfender for remote access. Now with .NET 10 and .NET 9 support and Bugfender SDK 3.6.0/2.2.0.
releaseNotes: v5.0.0: Updated bundled Bugfender native SDKs to Android 3.6.0 and iOS 2.2.0, including SDK type tagging for MAUI bindings and API URI support.
title: Bugfender SDK for .NET MAUI
